FEAT-3-S123.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Construction and Recruiting Filter Enforcement
FEAT-3-S123.description: Implement query construction logic to call ClinicalTrials.gov API with condition keywords and enforce RECRUITING status filter, including parameter normalization and pagination handling.

FEAT-3-S124.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
FEAT-3-S124.description: Extract trial site locations from API responses and normalize into structured geographic data (city, state, coordinates where available) for downstream distance computation.

FEAT-3-S125.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
FEAT-3-S125.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration between user location and each trial site, including batching and fallback handling for missing coordinates.

FEAT-3-S126.title: Clinical Trial Result Formatting for Chat Consumption
FEAT-3-S126.description: Format enriched trial data (metadata, recruiting status, locations, travel distance/duration) into structured, LLM-friendly response objects for downstream rendering in chat.
